You help an SRE team choose an observability stack. Each main decision has a recorded reason, and both the decisions and their reasons change as the evaluations go on.

- [e002] Decision: the telemetry collector is now `telegraf-agent`.
- [e003] Agreed in the sync: the continuous profiler becomes `parca-prof`.
- [e004] Update from Uma: the alert router is set to `pagerduty-rt`, effective now.
- [e005] After the review, the team settled on `gatus-check` for the uptime checker.
- [e006] Sami confirmed in writing that the status page host changes to `statuspal-host`.
- [e007] Update from Rosa: the log store is set to `openobserve`, effective now.
- [e008] Decision: the scrape interval in seconds is now `21`.
- [e009] Decision: the exemplar storage flag is now `OFF`.
- [e010] From now on, the supported locales include `hy-AM`.
- [e011] Added to the supported locales: `uz-UZ`.
- [e012] Approved: `az-AZ` joins the supported locales.
- [e013] After the review, the team settled on `32` for the trace sample rate per mille.
- [e014] Agreed in the sync: the log sampling flag becomes `OFF`.
- [e015] Mei recorded the reason for the metrics backend decision: `rsn-cost`.
- [e016] Rosa recorded the reason for the telemetry collector decision: `rsn-security`.
- [e017] Tove recorded the reason for the continuous profiler decision: `rsn-ops-load`.
- [e018] For the record, Oona wrote down the reason for the alert router decision: `rsn-compliance`.
- [e019] For the record, Vik wrote down the reason for the uptime checker decision: `rsn-vendor-lock`.

Rules for this task:
- A value changes only by an event that decides, corrects, adds, removes, renames, runs or restores it. A proposal, a question, a link or a quote of an old page changes nothing.
- A correction or a new decision replaces the earlier value. The earlier value is then superseded.
- The initial specification gives the first value of each item.
- A question about the values of an item "at some point" counts every value from the initial specification on, up to the time of the question.
- Each tool and each setting has one current decision. A new decision for it replaces the earlier one.
- A superseded value of an item is a value that was its decision at some time, the initial specification included, and is not its current decision.
- A locale is supported from the event that adds it until an event removes it.
- Some decisions have a recorded reason. A reason is one id of this closed list: `rsn-cost`, `rsn-latency`, `rsn-security`, `rsn-compliance`, `rsn-ops-load`, `rsn-vendor-lock`, `rsn-team-skill`.
- Each decision with a recorded reason has one reason at a time. An entry that records a reason for it replaces the earlier reason.
- A new decision for such an item comes with an entry that records its reason. A later entry can replace the reason and keep the decision.
- A reason changes only by an entry that records it. A new decision with no such entry keeps the earlier reason. A proposed reason changes nothing.
Every event has a label of the form [eNNN] with a three-digit number. A higher number is later in time. A later event can change or cancel an earlier one.
Some material quotes old pages or copies for history. A quote of that kind is not a new statement.
